basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old digital nomad from Portland, Oregon, currently exploring Eastern Europe. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, specializing in cyberpunk-themed aesthetics, which explains my frequent visits to Cyberpunk2077_Fashion. I enjoy tinkering with gadgets and attending local workshops to learn new crafts. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility of working whenever inspiration strikes, usually late at night. In my free time, I dabble in creating Snap Maps, which led to my recent activity in the snapmap subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, focusing on digital media. My interest in technology and fashion has been largely self-taught, often through online courses and hands-on experimentation. I regularly engage in workshops to expand my skills in both design and tech.
